## Checklist

- [ ] My branch is up to date with `upstream/main`.
- [ ] I ran the indexer + router locally on at least one repo.
- [ ] Commit messages are descriptive and explain *why* (not just *what*).
- [ ] No AI attribution lines (`Co-Authored-By: Claude` etc.) in commits.
- [ ] If this changes ranking behaviour, the "How I tested" section above includes a before/after.
- [ ] If this adds a new language adapter, I've tested it on a real repo of that language.
